-chrome-data-dir.help: path to store chrome browser data

-chrome-ws-url.help: use chrome browser instance launched elsewhere with the debugger listening at this URL

-concurrency.help: number of concurrent fetchers to use (default 10)

-config.help: path to the katana configuration file

-crawl-duration.help: maximum duration to crawl the target for (s, m, h, d) (default s)

-crawl-out-scope.help: out of scope url regex to be excluded by crawler

-crawl-scope.help: in scope url regex to be followed by crawler

-delay.help: request delay between each request in seconds

-display-out-scope.help: display external endpoint from scoped crawling

-dom-wait-time.help: time in seconds to wait after page load when using domcontentloaded strategy (default 5)

-error-log.help: file to write sent requests error log

-exclude.help: exclude host matching specified filter ('cdn', 'private-ips', cidr, ip, regex)

-extension-filter.help: filter output for given extension (eg, -ef png,css)

-extension-match.help: match output for given extension (eg, -em php,html,js,none)

-field.help: field to display in output (url,path,fqdn,rdn,rurl,qurl,qpath,file,ufile,key,value,kv,dir,udir) (Deprecated: use -output-template instead)

-field-config.help: path to custom field configuration file

-field-scope.help: pre-defined scope field (dn,rdn,fqdn) or custom regex (e.g., '(company-staging.io|company.com)') (default "rdn")

-filter-condition.help: filter response with dsl based condition

-filter-page-type.help: filter response with page type (e.g. error,captcha,parked)

-filter-regex.help: regex or list of regex to filter on output url (cli, file)

-filter-similar.help: filter crawling of similar looking URLs (e.g., /users/123 and /users/456)

-filter-similar-threshold.help: number of distinct values before a path position is treated as parameter (default 10)

-form-config.help: path to custom form configuration file

-form-extraction.help: extract form, input, textarea & select elements in jsonl output

-headers.help: custom header/cookie to include in all http request in header:value format (file)

-headless-options.help: start headless chrome with additional options

-host-rate-limit.help: maximum requests to send per second per host

-host-rate-limit-minute.help: maximum number of requests to send per minute per host

-ignore-query-params.help: Ignore crawling same path with different query-param values

-js-crawl.help: enable endpoint parsing / crawling in javascript file

-jsluice.help: enable jsluice parsing in javascript file (memory intensive)

-known-files.help: enable crawling of known files (all,robotstxt,sitemapxml), a minimum depth of 3 is required to ensure all known files are properly crawled.

-list-output-fields.help: list available fields for jsonl output format

-match-condition.help: match response with dsl based condition

-match-regex.help: regex or list of regex to match on output url (cli, file)

-max-domain-pages.help: maximum number of pages to crawl per domain (default unlimited)

-no-color.help: disable output content coloring (ANSI escape codes)

-no-default-ext-filter.help: remove default extensions from the filter list

-no-incognito.help: start headless chrome without incognito mode

-omit-body.help: omit response body from jsonl output

-omit-raw.help: omit raw requests/responses from jsonl output

-page-load-strategy.help: page load strategy (heuristic, load, domcontentloaded, networkidle, none) (default "heuristic")

-parallelism.help: number of concurrent inputs to process (default 10)

-passive.help: enable passive sources to discover target endpoints

-passive-source.help: passive source to use for url discovery (waybackarchive,commoncrawl,alienvault)

-rate-limit.help: maximum requests to send per second (default 150)

-rate-limit-minute.help: maximum number of requests to send per minute

-resolvers.help: list of custom resolver (file or comma separated)

-retry.help: number of times to retry the request (default 1)

-show-browser.help: show the browser on the screen with headless mode

-store-field.help: field to store in per-host output (url,path,fqdn,rdn,rurl,qurl,qpath,file,ufile,key,value,kv,dir,udir)

-store-field-dir.help: store per-host field to custom directory

-store-response-dir.help: store http requests/responses to custom directory

-system-chrome.help: use local installed chrome browser instead of katana installed

-system-chrome-path.help: use specified chrome browser for headless crawling

-timeout.help: time to wait for request in seconds (default 10)

-tls-impersonate.help: enable experimental client hello (ja3) tls randomization

-xhr-extraction.help: extract xhr request url,method in jsonl output
